question_text: Read the passage carefully and complete the table below
stimulus: with information from the passage. 1×5=5 Your hair and every cell in your body contain your own unique DNA. It can tell you a lot Subject Code : about your family, health and personality. DNA was discovered by a German scientist, Friedrich Miescher in 1869, but nobody realized its importance then. Other scientists thought that it was too simple to contain the map of how we are made! In 1953, a group of British scientists of Cambridge University finally discovered the structure of DNA and how it worked. They were given the Nobel Prize for Medicine in 1962. Gradually, scientists learned to ‘read’ more of the information in DNA. In 1986, for the first time DNA test was used by the police. Some DNA are usually left by a criminal at the place where the crime was committed. This can be matched with DNA from a suspect. The test shows if the suspect is guilty. When Who/Where Event/Action 1869 (i) ......... (ii) ......... 1962 (iii) ......... were given Nobel Prize for Medicine (iv) ....... Police use DNA test for the first time. Criminal (iv) .........
guide_solution: Information transfer (i) German scientist fried rich Miescher; (ii) discovered DNA; (iii) A group of British scientists; (iv) 1986; (v) at the place where crime was committed

subject: English
question_text: The bar chart shows the growth rate of industrial
stimulus: production in Bangladesh in the years 1997-2003. Write a paragraph using the information give below and give a title to it. 10
guide_solution: Graph & charts Within a short period of time after independence, Bangladesh has notably advanced in industrial production to keep pace with the world. The chart covers only five years starting from 1997 to 2003. In 2001 the production growth reached to the highest pick of 6.2% while with 6.1% in 2000 became second. Of the rest, growth rate of 2002 is just 1.8%, the lowest figure of the chart. And the next year in 2003, industrial output was 4% that is third there. But 1997 the rate was only 2.5%. According to the chart, we can easily say that ups and downs prevailed in 170 Bangladesh’s production growth rate during the aforesaid years.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 125 — Holy Cross Girls' High School, Dhaka

subject: English
question_text: Dhaka City Corporation is installing solar panels instead of
stimulus: conventional lights to illuminate roads in many areas. Write a letter to the editor of a daily newspaper appreciating this intiative and saying why this should be followed by other city authorities too. 10
guide_solution: Letter to Editor 01 October 2015 The Editor The Daily Star Karwan Bazar, Dhaka. Sir, I shall be obliged if you kindly publish the following letter in your esteemed daily. Your truly, M.A. Zaman on behalf of the Dhaka city dwellers Installing Solar Panels instead of Coventional lights It is a very happy news for the Dhaka city dwellers that Dhaka City Corporation is installing solar panels instead of conventional lights to illuminate roads in many ways. It saves money and it is less costly. It is called green energy which never exhausts. There is no possibility of being load- shedding. All the Dhaka city dwellers are praising highly for the steps taken by Dhaka city corporation. I think other city corporation authories also should follow it.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 125 — Holy Cross Girls' High School, Dhaka
